mappings.assertion: TestA6TypedSetsKeepWireSpelling pins the A6 sets typed by the concern tasks (batch end reasons, run outcomes, ruling actions and outcomes, the evaluator's ten progress codes) and TestA6ProgressCodesKeepWireSpelling the five deferred-validation progress codes and the exported string wait, each against the wire literal independently of the constant. TestA6DeferredValidationVocabularyKeepsWireSpelling pins the skip reasons, unattributed reasons, discovery keys, ID and once-key formats, lane, pathspec, lock, operation, env-file, file-extension and subcommand names, modes, and the status window. TestA6WorktreeSetupOutcomeStatusKeepsWireSpelling drives the real outcome file (bytes written and read back, unknown status malformed). TestA6AdoptedOwnerValuesKeepTheirSpelling ties the adopted owner constants (notFoundEntityTask text, gitMode*, codePlanningRolePair, actorOperator, the A3 safe actions and effects) to their literals. IntegrationReason keeps TestIntegrationReasonValuesAndDiagnosticType. Negative proof, restored: changing not_due to not_due_x and the failed status word to fail failed the two pins by name.

The A6 oracle suite (TestOracleWtMerge and every other delivered case) runs live in make test at index 0 against unchanged goldens, and the regen check at index 4 reproduces them from the starting tree; git diff of internal/oracle against the integration HEAD is empty because every substitution keeps its value and wire bytes.

The test target (go test ./...) runs the ops, archguard and oracle suites including k7_a6_vocabulary_test.go at index 0; lint at index 1, test-e2e at index 2, the race run over ops, commands, cmd/liza, jsonout and agent at index 3 and the A6 regen check at index 4 are mandatory with it.
